art_style: Mochiichao art style of record (repo canon art); NO baked-in shadows (composite-time only)

bone_layers.deform: only weighted bones/layers; URS invariants measured here: <=4 influences per vertex, weights sum to 1, welded, zero NaN
bone_layers.mechanism: IK chains, switch/snap helpers, lattice drivers; zero weights, always

deformation.holds: animate on 2s/3s; held body with mouth/eyes only for dialogue (HB method; humans only - creatures do not dialogue)
deformation.smear_frames: dedicated smear drawings for fast limb moves (house style)
deformation.squash_stretch: volume-preserving scale on torso+head groups; anticipation 4-8f on jumps

face_system.method: stepped library of approved shapes (2D: Graphic symbol frames; 3D: action-driven poses) - one design, both tracks

gate: Universal Rig Standard adapted: ROM battery is a generated test pose set run on every version + before/after proof frames reviewed by eye; 3D track stretch gate p99.9 < 2.5; no ship without pass

generation.method: scaffold_is_metarig: place joints on Stage 2 construction lines, assign components, generate; proportion changes = scaffold edit + regenerate
generation.post_gen_notes: house tweaks live here, never as hand edits to a generated rig (Universal Rig Standard: no hand-tooling)

shape_key_budget: <=10 corrective shape keys / drawings per rig (open-movie discipline); solve with structure first
source_system: open-movie rig teardown (RIG-TEARDOWN.md): metarig+components generation, three bone layers, fixed deformation stack, lattice patches, face-as-library

mouth.note: Preston Blair 10-shape viseme set for HUMANS ONLY (stepped by mochiichao-mouth-data/v1). Creatures use species cry/expression shapes in this same slot - cries-only law.
